preprocessing.orientationHandling: No EXIF orientation application; the decoder raw pixel grid is used as returned.
preprocessing.colorHandling: RGB channels are used when available; grayscale and alpha-bearing inputs are handled deterministically without alpha.
preprocessing.canonicalCrop: Centered native-grid 1024x1024 crop chosen from decoded dimensions before extraction; no resize.

patchSelection.ranking: All sixteen spatial cells are used in row-major order; no variance ranking or semantic selection.

features.definition: Ninetieth-to-median absolute residual ratio with a fixed epsilon.
features.preprocessing: Native decoded pixel values; no metadata, filename, dimensions, file size, encoder or truth input.
features.aggregationRule: Median across the sixteen fixed-grid patch measurements.
features.degenerateFeatureHandling: Non-finite values are omitted; a feature is excluded only by the calibration-only finite-count or variance rule.
features.missingValueHandling: The image is unavailable if fewer than four selected features are finite at scoring time.
